# Amazon OpenSearch Serverless

Manage collection and security policy records; no search data plane is served.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `opensearchserverless` |

| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.0 |
| API version | `2021-11-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-opensearch-serverless) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only, no search data plane: collection and dashboard endpoints have AWS-shaped URLs but serve no data, indexes, queries or dashboard.
- No VPC endpoints or SAML security configurations; no provisioning or EC2 networking integration; network sources and IAM/KMS principals are syntax-checked metadata, not authorization or connectivity.
- No collection groups, vector options, deletion protection, lifecycle policies or data plane operations; unsupported request members are rejected.
- Reads return the current collection lifecycle state then advance it; inventory does not advance state; idempotency records persist until reset.
- Capacity settings are records only and do not allocate or meter OCUs; no quota enforcement.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
